build_biknn_radius_graph: build a BiKNN radius graph from an AtomicData object with PBC image replication and soft or hard ranking
build_batched_radius_graph: build a batched BiKNN radius graph for multiple systems with padded neighbor tensors and envelope filtering
build_radius_graph_single: build a BiKNN radius graph for a single system given positions, cell, image IDs, and cutoff parameters
build_radius_graph_chunked: build a memory-efficient chunked BiKNN radius graph processing source atoms in configurable chunk sizes
compute_soft_rank_low_mem: compute approximate soft rankings for distances using a truncated k-plus-delta approach with the bump function
